theme.archetype: The Performance Pro / Swiss High-Contrast (Adapted for DevOps)
theme.description: A 'Command-Center' focus. High-visibility tactical look designed for internal infrastructure management. Pure function, high data density, no distracting gradients.

accent.name: Signal Orange
accent.usage: AWS-inspired accent color for Primary CTAs (e.g., 'Generate Terraform', 'Upload CSV') and active states.

headings.usage: Page titles, widget headers. Must be tracked tightly (-0.02em).

body.usage: Standard UI text, form labels, descriptions.

monospace.usage: IP addresses, Ports, DNS records, and Terraform HCL/JSON code blocks. CRITICAL for data tables.

spacing_and_layout.grid: Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboards. Use col-span-1 for summary metric widgets, col-span-3 for larger tables.
spacing_and_layout.borders_and_radius: Sharp, technical edges. Max 4px border-radius (rounded-sm). Use 1px solid strokes (border-white/10) instead of soft shadows.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces. NO Glassmorphism. Avoid visual refraction for data-heavy apps. Use #18181B for cards.

navigation.sidebar: Fixed left, solid background (#09090B), right border (border-white/10). Contains navigation links (Dashboard, Inventory, DNS/SRV, Generator).
navigation.header: Sticky top, solid background (#09090B), bottom border. Contains global actions (e.g., Bulk Upload CSV button, Search).

components.data_tables: Dense layout. Use monospaced font for technical columns (IP, Port, Instance ID). Include hover states (bg-white/5) on rows.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Inputs and Selects. Left-aligned labels. Ring color on focus must be ring-orange-500/50.
components.code_editor_view: For Terraform Generator: Darker background block (#000000 or #09090B inner box) with JetBrains Mono, syntax highlighting colors (e.g., green for strings, orange for keywords), and a 'Copy to Clipboard' absolute button in top right.
components.buttons: Rectangular (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-orange-500 text-white hover:bg-orange-600. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 hover:bg-white/10.

visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react for standard UI icons. Keep stroke width to 1.5 or 2 for clarity.
visual_enhancers.textures: Grid Borders: Make the grid visible on the dashboard using border-collapse or subtle dividers to expose the skeleton of the UI.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subtle dashed borders (border-dashed border-white/20) with muted text to indicate where data should be (e.g., 'No DNS records found.').

image_urls.description: Abstract dark background texture, can be used at very low opacity (e.g., 5%) for empty state banners or login screens if needed.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary orange (#F97316) meets 4.5:1 ratio against #09090B. Use text-white for text inside primary buttons.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have visible focus rings.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Keep animations purely functional (fast transitions 150ms).

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data clarity and density. This is an internal tool for DevOps, so it should feel like a modern, polished IDE or terminal.
Use `recharts` for the Stats Overview (Instance Role breakdown, etc).
For the Terraform Generator view, output the generated text inside a `<pre><code>` block with `JetBrains Mono` font. Include a functional 'Copy HCL' / 'Copy JSON' button.
Ensure the CSV Bulk Upload has a clear drag-and-drop zone with a dashed border.
DO NOT use Inter or generic fonts for the Terraform output; monospaced font is mandatory for that section.
Ensure all interactive elements include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="generate-tf-button"`).
Remove `.App-logo` and generic centered text from `App.css`. Left-align forms and data.
Force dark mode by adding the 'dark' class to the HTML/body or root element by default.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Left-align for natural reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (rounded-sm) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
